description: This file defines the NoteService class, which provides business logic and transactional operations for managing notes in a backend application. It includes methods for finding, creating, updating, and deleting notes, interacting with a NoteRepository.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service layer class for managing notes, providing methods to find, create, update, and delete notes.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes, read-only transaction.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided NoteRequest.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with data from NoteRequest.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, throws NotFoundException if the note does not exist.
